description: Source code for managing size classes in jemalloc, including functions for computing size class parameters, initializing size class data, and updating slab sizes.

classes.name: sc_t
classes.description: Structure representing a size class in jemalloc.

classes.name: sc_data_t
classes.description: Structure holding global size class data and configuration.

methods.name: reg_size_compute
methods.description: Computes the size of a region based on logarithmic base and delta values.

methods.name: slab_size
methods.description: Calculates the number of pages in a slab for a given size class configuration.

methods.name: size_class
methods.description: Initializes a size class structure with computed parameters.

methods.name: size_classes
methods.description: Generates and initializes all size classes based on system parameters.

methods.name: sc_data_init
methods.description: Initializes the global size class data.

methods.name: sc_data_update_sc_slab_size
methods.description: Updates slab size for a specific size class based on region size.

methods.name: sc_data_update_slab_size
methods.description: Updates slab sizes for all relevant size classes within a range.

methods.name: sc_boot
methods.description: Bootstraps and initializes size class data.
